summary.prose: Building this Story means adding one new module, checkpoint.ts, with three small functions and the same symlink-safety and atomic-publish machinery s4 already proved out in review-report.ts, plus a full named test suite covering all four acceptance criteria and every error/edge case the LLD names. Two Tasks: the module itself (t1), then its complete test suite (t2).

tasks.title: Add ReviewCheckpoint and writeCheckpoint/readCheckpoint/finalizeAndCleanup to a new checkpoint.ts
tasks.summary: New src/workflow/review-round/checkpoint.ts exporting the ReviewCheckpoint interface and the three functions exactly per the LLD's contract: reviewId literal-identifier validation, canonical repo resolution, lstat-based symlink safety before every write/delete, and a guarded temp-file+rename publish for writeCheckpoint (reusing review-report.ts's publishGuarded pattern) so a crash mid-write never leaves a corrupted checkpoint. finalizeAndCleanup copies finalOutput into durable storage before deleting .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/, never the reverse, and is idempotent when called twice. readCheckpoint treats a missing or malformed checkpoint file identically (undefined), never throwing. Plus a compile-time typecheck fixture proving the exact three-function/ReviewCheckpoint shape (matching review-report.ts's own __type-tests__ convention). Sized M: this bundles three functions plus the full symlink-safety and guarded-publish scope from the start, comparable to review-report.ts's final state rather than its initial draft.
acceptanceChecks: writeCheckpoint, readCheckpoint and finalizeAndCleanup exist with exactly the signatures in contractDetails.api, and ReviewCheckpoint exists with exactly dataModelChanges' shape
writeCheckpoint publishes via a guarded temp-file+rename primitive (never a direct writeFileSync), satisfying the atomic-write error case
finalizeAndCleanup's durable copy always precedes its .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ deletion, and a copy failure leaves the temp folder intact
readCheckpoint resolves to undefined for a missing OR malformed checkpoint file, never throwing on corruption
every write and the recursive delete are preceded by an lstat-based symlink-safety check reusing review-report.ts's established helper
the typecheck fixture compiles and fails to compile under every @ts-expect-error negative case

tests.name: writeCheckpoint writes a ReviewCheckpoint JSON record to .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/checkpoint.json containing exactly {reviewId, lastCompletedUnit}, overwriting any prior checkpoint for the same reviewId

tasks.title: Add the full named test suite for checkpoint.ts covering ac1-ac4 and all error/edge cases
tasks.summary: One it() per testStrategy.testLevels[0].subjects (14 total), matching ac1-ac4's acceptanceMapping.provingTests verbatim (6 subjects), plus the 8 remaining error-case/edge-case subjects (idempotent finalize, repeated-write overwrite, path-traversal, repo-resolution, symlinked write, symlinked delete, corrupted-checkpoint, finalize-with-no-checkpoint). Mirrors reconciliation.test.ts's/review-report.test.ts's own fixture conventions: disposable .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ directories cleaned up per test, an injectable resolveRepoRoot test double, and an injectable durable-copy-destination double so finalizeAndCleanup's write can be forced to fail without touching real artifact storage.
acceptanceChecks: All 14 named subjects from testStrategy.testLevels[0].subjects exist as individual it() cases with titles matching verbatim
ac1, ac2, ac3 and ac4's acceptanceMapping.provingTests all pass
npx tsc --noEmit and npx tsx --test for the new test file both pass with zero failures
the broader sweep (src/workflow/review-round/**/*.test.ts) still passes in full, confirming no regression to s1-s4's existing suites

tests.name: readCheckpoint resolves to undefined when no checkpoint file exists yet for a reviewId, rather than throwing
readCheckpoint resolves to the last-written ReviewCheckpoint after writeCheckpoint has been called, so a resumed review can continue from lastCompletedUnit rather than re-running completed units
readCheckpoint's own reviewId field, read back from the checkpoint record, is exactly the identity k8 requires -- the same string as both the temp folder name and the record's own content
finalizeAndCleanup copies finalOutput into durable artifact storage before deleting the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder, in that order
if finalizeAndCleanup's durable copy write fails, the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder is not deleted
finalizeAndCleanup is idempotent: calling it a second time for a reviewId whose temp folder was already deleted by an earlier successful call succeeds without error
writeCheckpoint called repeatedly for the same reviewId overwrites the prior checkpoint rather than accumulating a history
a reviewId containing a path-traversal segment is rejected before any filesystem access, for writeCheckpoint, readCheckpoint, and finalizeAndCleanup alike
when the reviewed repository cannot be resolved, writeCheckpoint/readCheckpoint/finalizeAndCleanup reject rather than silently defaulting to the daemon process's own cwd
a symlinked review directory or checkpoint file is never written through by writeCheckpoint, even outside .insrc/tmp
a symlinked .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ directory is never deleted through by finalizeAndCleanup

a checkpoint.json file that is not valid JSON, or does not match ReviewCheckpoint's shape, is treated by readCheckpoint as though no checkpoint exists, rather than throwing or returning unvalidated data
finalizeAndCleanup succeeds even when checkpoint.json was never written at all, deleting whatever the .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ folder currently contains as a whole
